correctness.rationale: The ordinary matching complex has face vector (12,42,44,9). Independently of the submitted Morse matching, each size-three matching extends to at most one size-four matching, because only two cube vertices remain. Collapsing a free triangle in each of nine tetrahedra leaves 35 triangles; a spanning tree of the one-skeleton identifies integral 1-cycles with 31 cotree coordinates. Unit-pivot elimination makes the remaining triangle boundaries onto on these coordinates, so reduced integral homology is Z^4 only in degree two. A distance-preserving permutation census obtains all 48 elements. An invariant matching is a union of edge cycles; each chosen cycle contributes one minus sign to the reduced Euler weight, with a further global minus sign. The resulting paired traces (4,2),(-2,0),(0,-2),(1,-1),(0,2) have multiplicities 1,6,3,8,6 in each parity and equal sign(diagonal action) times (number of fixed diagonals minus 1 plus geometric determinant). The ordinary quotient statement follows after barycentric subdivision by rational coinvariants, equivalent to invariants by averaging. No integral quotient claim follows.
